column1: # Spirality's tickets, classed by reading each one (SP-348, 2026-11-16).
# The values and what they mean: docs/LOOP_CONTRACT.md, "A ticket's kind, who started it and how it ended".
# - kind: Feature unless the note or the rules below say otherwise. Loop and tracker work is
#   Spirality's feature work. Fix = something that should already have worked (a refusal, a
#   wrong page, a check that misread). Operational = every merge-conflict fix-up, plus
#   SP-35 and SP-98 (named in the note). Documentation = only written rules, plans or
# - started_by: operator when the ticket quotes Dane asking for it, or Dane choosing to have
#   it filed ("yes, file it", an option he picked). agent when a loop or session filed it
#   from something it found, with no words of Dane's naming it: every merge-conflict fix-up,
#   and the follow-ups found during a migration or an incident.
# - outcome: Done for every Live ticket, except Won't do (tagged wont-do or deferred) and
#   Duplicate (named in the note). Open tickets have none. No Spirality ticket is a test ticket.
